name: Main Site Runtime Bridge
goal: 讓主站可直接搬用 server-side AI composer、HMAC internal client、後台審核 UI、文章排程與 KB 健康檢查。
hard_rules: AI provider key must stay on the main-site server runtime, never in browser JavaScript.
Knowledge backend does not generate article body; it only provides grounded source packets and validation governance.
Beinan/Peinan archaeological site terms are forbidden as Pinuyumayan cultural sources, synonyms, tags, related content, or article evidence.
Public endpoints must never return restricted/rejected/blocked_license/admin_only claims.
Internal endpoints must require API key + HMAC timestamp + nonce + signature in production.

copy_to_main_site.purpose: 主站 server route 對知識庫 internal API 簽章。
主站 server-side AI 作文入口。
主站檢查後端知識庫連線與 HMAC。
前端輸入想法 + 選史料包。

runtime_flow: main-site browser loads composer config and source packet list from public KB endpoints
main-site user selects topic/blueprint and writes idea
main-site browser POSTs to its own /api/ai/compose
main-site server route resolves source packets and calls AI provider
main-site server route sends draft to KB validation endpoint with HMAC
KB returns citation, duplicate, forbidden relation, sensitivity, and license findings
if clean or reviewable, main-site submits to KB review queue
admin review workbench approves/schedules/publishes according to policy
